observations: The run sandbox pre-sets SEEDS_COMPAT_SD=/mise/bun-global/bin/sd-ref (toolchain-image baked sd-0.5.15), so compat/differential tests run live even before `bun install` provisioning — worth knowing when judging 'skip vs ran' from durations alone (I nearly mis-tested the skip path because of it).

sd 0.5.15's show has a flag-form quirk worth remembering: single missing id answers a failure envelope under `--json` but plain stderr `Error:` under `--format json`; multi-id partial failures emit an issues+results+errors envelope; all error paths exit 1. Pinned in main.rs run_show and README DEVIATIONS.

An earlier probe of mine read exit codes after a pipe (`sd ... | python ...; echo $?` captures python's exit), briefly suggesting a nonexistent exit-0-on-error path; direct probes corrected it — pipe exit-code reads are a easy way to mispin parity contracts.
